# hermes_profile (Resource)

Manages a named Hermes profile through the dashboard REST API. The `default` profile is protected and cannot be managed by this resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Lowercase Hermes profile name. The `default` profile is protected.

### Optional

- `clone_all` (Boolean) Clone the source profile's complete state during creation. Changing this requires replacement.
- `clone_from` (String) Optional existing profile to clone during creation. Changing this requires replacement.
- `description` (String) Human-readable profile description.
- `no_skills` (Boolean) Skip bundled skill seeding during creation. Changing this requires replacement.

### Read-Only

- `gateway_running` (Boolean)
- `has_env` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `model` (String) Currently selected main model, when reported by Hermes.
- `model_provider` (String) Currently selected model provider, when reported by Hermes.
- `skill_count` (Number)
